extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media professionals; general public seeking official IPCC communications
extracted.subtask_description: A web page listing and providing access to IPCC press releases, media advisories, statements and announcements; intended as an official repository for journalists and the public to obtain accurate information about IPCC activities and reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy and relevance of IPCC communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The IPCC supports the media to help them convey relevant and accurate information to the public on IPCC assessments and activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page contains all press and media related materials including press releases, media advisories, statements and announcements from the IPCC.
